tools.name: calculate_psa_grading_roi
tools.description: Calculate deterministic PSA / BGS / CGC card grading net profit, ROI %, expected value (EV), and break-even Gem Mint probability after 12.5% marketplace fees.

tools.name: calculate_card_centering_grade
tools.description: Calculate trading card border centering ratios (Left/Right and Top/Bottom in mm or px) and determine maximum eligible grades across PSA (55/45), BGS (Black Label 50/50), CGC, and TAG.

tools.name: lookup_tcg_card_market_price
tools.description: Look up raw TCGplayer USD, Cardmarket EUR, PSA 9, PSA 10, and BGS 9.5 graded prices for Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Sports cards by name or card number (e.g. "Charizard", "4/102", "Umbreon", "Blue-Eyes White Dragon").

tools.name: lookup_psa_bgs_cgc_grading_standards
tools.description: Look up exact front/back centering tolerances, corner sharpness, edge whitening, and surface rules for PSA 10 Gem Mint, BGS 10 Black Label, CGC 10 Pristine, and TAG 1000.

tools.name: identify_vintage_pokemon_edition_markers
tools.description: Identify 1999 Wizards of the Coast Pokemon Base Set print runs (1st Edition Thick/Thin Stamp, Shadowless Red Cheeks/Yellow Cheeks, Unlimited, 1999-2000 4th Print UK) from visual border and copyright cues.

tools.name: compare_card_grading_company_tiers
tools.description: Compare submission fees, maximum declared value caps, and estimated turnaround business days across PSA, Beckett (BGS), and CGC based on post-grading card value.

tools.name: estimate_ebay_tcgplayer_seller_net_payout
tools.description: Calculate net seller take-home payout after platform final value fees (eBay 13.25%, TCGplayer Pro/Level 4, Goldin/PWCC vault) and shipping insurance.

tools.name: check_card_sleeve_and_holder_dimensions
tools.description: Look up exact card dimensions in mm/inches and required submission holder specs (Card Saver 1 semi-rigid vs 35pt/55pt/130pt toploader) for Standard (Pokemon/MTG/Sports) vs Japanese (Yu-Gi-Oh!) cards.
